imagenet-128-samples.source: paper Figure 1, page 1 — extracted by Marker as paper-md-assets/_page_0_Figure_11.jpeg
imagenet-128-samples.caption: Unconditional ImageNet-128 samples of a CNF trained using Flow Matching with Optimal Transport probability paths.
imagenet-128-samples.attribution: Lipman, Chen, Ben-Hamu, Nickel, Le. Flow Matching for Generative Modeling. ICLR 2023 (arXiv:2210.02747).

ot-vs-diffusion-trajectories.source: paper Figure 6, page 8 — extracted by Marker as paper-md-assets/_page_7_Figure_4.jpeg; upscaled to 1920px wide via sips for caption-bar friendly aspect.
ot-vs-diffusion-trajectories.caption: Sample paths from the same initial noise with models trained on ImageNet 64x64. Left: Score Matching w/ Diffusion. Middle: Flow Matching w/ Diffusion. Right: Flow Matching w/ OT. The OT path reduces noise roughly linearly, while diffusion paths visibly remove noise only towards the end.
ot-vs-diffusion-trajectories.attribution: Lipman, Chen, Ben-Hamu, Nickel, Le. Flow Matching for Generative Modeling. ICLR 2023 (arXiv:2210.02747).

nfe-bar-chart.method: hand-coded SVG, 1920x1080, dark navy bg #0e1117, 3b1b palette (#58c4dd blue, #ffeb3b yellow, #f97583 red).
nfe-bar-chart.data_source: NFE values pulled from Table 1 of the paper (ImageNet 64x64 column, dopri5 adaptive solver, tolerance 1e-5, averaged over 50k samples): ScoreFlow=601, Score Matching=441, DDPM=264, FM w/ Diffusion=187, FM w/ OT=138.
